semiconductor_relevance: High — Chip Shine Electronics specializes in the manufacturing of test probes and sockets, which are critical components in semiconductor testing processes.
summary: Chip Shine Electronics Technology Co., Ltd. is a high-tech enterprise focused on the R&D, design, production, and sales of precision test probes and sockets for the semiconductor industry. With over 20 years of experience, the company offers a range of testing solutions including ICT and burn-in test probes, catering to various semiconductor applications.
capabilities: R&D and production of test probes for ICT and semiconductor applications
Manufacturing of burn-in test probes with matching modules
Precision machining for components with tolerances of 0.001-0.005mm

regional_presence.China: The company is based in Shanghai and collaborates with domestic universities for R&D.
